mapper.select: SELECT pmo.MO_OID as ticketId, pmo.ORDER_STATUS as status, mc.CUSTOMER_ORGANIZATION as customerOrganization, pmo.ORDER_DATE as createdDate, user.NAME as responder FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.PREP_MASTER_ORDER pmo JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_CUSTOMER mc USING(MC_OID) LEFT JOIN BASIL_SEC_PRD.XREF_RESPONSE resp USING(MO_OID) LEFT JOIN BASIL_SEC_PRD.USERS user ON resp.RESPONSE_BY = user.U_OID WHERE pmo.ACKNOWLEDGED = 0
